cells.value: An object at rest remains at rest
cells.quote: An object at rest remains at rest, and an object in motion remains in motion at constant speed and in a straight line

cells.value: The acceleration of an object depends on the mass
cells.quote: The acceleration of an object depends on the mass of the object and the amount of force applied.

cells.value: Whenever one object exerts a force on a second object
cells.quote: Whenever one object exerts a force on a second object, the second object exerts an equal and opposite force on the first.
